title: CAPIT Dashboard | National Well Plugging Tracker
description: Filter verified plugged-well records, compare state activity, and review CAPIT source context, freshness, and immutable revisions.
headline: National Well Plugging Dashboard
body: Use the CAPIT dashboard to filter published well-plugging records by state, source, timeframe, and record status. Every panel clearly exposes its specific scope, data source, and freshness, ensuring you have the exact context behind the numbers.

sections.heading: The Trust Engine
sections.body: The CAPIT dashboard aggregates fragmented public well-plugging records into a single, verified snapshot. Users can monitor:
bullets: **Verified Plugged-Well Records:** The total count of public records that have passed CAPIT's strict publication and verification rules.
**CAPIT Mint Activity:** On-chain protocol activity strictly linked to our 1:1 minting logic (one token = one verified well).
**State Coverage & Comparison:** Visual map data and leaderboards to compare remediation efforts across different states.

sections.heading: Unalterable Provenance
sections.body: Public records can frequently be revised, corrected, or reclassified by state agencies. Instead of pretending the data is static, CAPIT’s dashboard preserves a visible, immutable revision trail directly on the Base network. Every verified record displayed in the Recent Verified Records table includes its source agency, verification date, and a transparent provenance link to the underlying state registry.

sections.heading: Definitions and Caveats
sections.body: State definitions differ. Some source systems publish orphan wells, some publish plugged wells, and some expose only partial subsets. CAPIT shows the exact scope of every panel in plain language to maintain data integrity.
